title: Payable Closing Costs on the Closing Disclosure by Loan Program and Pricing
content:
**Disclosure desk note — Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, payable closing costs**

For a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant's closing-cost entry, which charges on the latest Closing Disclosure are payable depends on the loan program and pricing recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File:

- on an FHA or VA file (Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed), the payable closing costs are the zero-tolerance total plus the 10 percent tolerance total on the Closing Disclosure;
- on any other file flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan, they are the zero-tolerance total alone;
- on any other file, they are the nonrecurring closing costs.

The FHA or VA test is read first: an FHA or VA file takes the zero-tolerance total plus the 10 percent tolerance total whether or not it is flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan.

| Loan program | Flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan | Payable closing costs |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | yes or no | zero-tolerance total plus 10 percent tolerance total |
| any other program | yes | zero-tolerance total alone |
| any other program | no | nonrecurring closing costs |

### Worked example (hypothetical Closing Disclosure)

A latest Closing Disclosure shows nonrecurring closing costs of 9100.00, a zero-tolerance total of 4300.00 and a 10 percent tolerance total of 2200.00.

| File | Payable closing costs |
|---|---|
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 6500.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, flagged as a higher-priced mortgage loan | 4300.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, not flagged | 9100.00 |
